patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Airtable and Trello share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Frame: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Airtable and Trello share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.. Choose Airtable only if your buying job matches “Flexible database / app platform with interfaces and light project apps — Team from ~$20/u” rather than Trello's shape. Choose Trello only if your buying job matches “Lightweight Kanban boards (Atlassian) — Free; Standard from $5/user/mo annual.” rather than Airtable's shape. Workflow advantage: Airtable leans work-management; Trello leans team-collaboration-work. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Airtable and Trello share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: Airtable is Flexible database / app platform with interfaces and light project apps — Team from ~$20/user/mo annual.; Trello is Lightweight Kanban boards (Atlassian) — Free; Standard from $5/user/mo annual..
- Company-size focus: Airtable (small-business, mid-market, enterprise) vs Trello (micro, small-business, mid-market).
- Workflow coverage skew: Airtable-leaning work-management vs Trello-leaning team-collaboration-work.
- Researched limits: Airtable — Higher seat floors than Notion/ClickUp; Trello — Limited planning depth vs Work OS.

Limitations — Airtable: Higher seat floors than Notion/ClickUp; Builder complexity; Trello: Limited planning depth vs Work OS; Premium needed for richer views.

Poor-fit cases: Airtable is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Higher seat floors than Notion/ClickUp · Trello is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Limited planning depth vs Work OS · Avoid Airtable if you actually need Trello's motion (Lightweight Kanban boards (Atlassian) — Free; Standard from $5/user/mo annual.)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
